subject: English 2nd Paper
topic: Section A - Ques 3: Right Form of Verbs

items.text:
Fill in the blanks with the correct form of the verbs given in brackets.
Man (a) —— (be) the maker of his own fortune. If we have fear of work, we cannot (b) —— (prosper) in life. Some people think that success in life (c) —— (depend) on luck or chance. Scientists have (d) —— (toil) day and night in their laboratories with a view to (e) —— (invent) radio, television and computer. These instruments have added to the joy of our life.
items.explanation: Suggested answers: (a) is; (b) prosper; (c) depends; (d) toiled; (e) inventing.
items.page: Class-8-English-Model-Tests.pdf, PDF page 16, English Second Paper, question 3
